title: Tom Collins
paragraphs: [[person|tom-collins|Tom Collins]] appears in 31 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1956. The credits here include performer.

plain_text:
Tom Collins appears in 31 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1956. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Tom Collins most often in The Adventures of Frank Race, The Whistler, Lux Radio Theatre, and X Minus One.

Characters credited here include Frank Race.
